item.title: Bangkok Guilt by Street Origins – 1ml Sample Decant
item.description:
Vendor: Street Origins
Type:
Price: 2.49

Overview

Exotic, playful, and irresistibly addictive, Bangkok Guilt by Street Origins is a floral fruity gourmand fragrance that blends vibrant tropical fruits, creamy florals, and warm vanilla woods into a scent that feels both seductive and carefree. It opens with a juicy burst of blackcurrant, pineapple, and passionfruit, creating a bright and energetic introduction that immediately draws attention. As the fragrance develops, jasmine, ylang-ylang, iris, and a gourmand accord add a creamy floral sweetness before settling into a smooth base of vanilla, musk, patchouli, and woods.

Bangkok Guilt captures the excitement of Bangkok's nightlife, balancing fruity sweetness with creamy sophistication and a warm, lingering dry down.

Fragrance Notes

Top: Blackcurrant, Pineapple, Passionfruit

Middle: Jasmine, Ylang-Ylang, Iris, Gourmand Accord

Base: Woody Notes, Musk, Patchouli, Vanilla

Inspired & Occasion

Bangkok Guilt is built around the contrast of juicy tropical fruits and a creamy floral-gourmand heart. The pineapple and passionfruit provide a vibrant opening, while iris and gourmand notes add a smooth, slightly powdery sweetness. The vanilla, musk, and patchouli base creates a warm and addictive finish that feels modern, playful, and luxurious.

Perfect for:

  • Date nights
  • Vacations
  • Evening wear
  • Spring & summer nights
  • Social events
  • Gourmand fragrance lovers
  • Those who enjoy fruity-floral scents with depth

Try Before You Commit

Bangkok Guilt opens with an explosion of tropical fruits, led by juicy pineapple and passionfruit, creating an uplifting and attention-grabbing first impression. As it settles, the floral heart emerges, with jasmine, ylang-ylang, and iris blending seamlessly into the gourmand accord to create a creamy and addictive character. The dry down reveals smooth vanilla, musk, patchouli, and woods, leaving behind a warm, sensual trail that lingers for hours. If you enjoy fragrances that combine tropical sweetness, soft florals, and a rich vanilla finish, Bangkok Guilt delivers a fun yet sophisticated scent experience.

Bold, aquatic, and unexpectedly addictive, Nomad by French Avenue is an oriental woody fragrance that combines salty marine accords with warm vanilla, amber, and earthy woods. As the fragrance develops, marine notes and white florals bring a fresh oceanic character before settling into a rich base of vanilla, amber, cypriol, and patchouli. The contrast between salty freshness and creamy warmth gives Nomad its unique signature.

Nomad delivers a powerful, modern scent profile that feels both fresh and deep, making it a fragrance that evolves dramatically throughout the wear.

Fragrance Notes

Top: Saffron, Lemon

Middle: Marine Notes, White Flowers

Base: Vanilla, Amber, Cypriol, Patchouli

Inspired & Occasion

Nomad is built around the contrast of marine freshness and warm ambery sweetness. The salty oceanic accord is balanced by creamy vanilla and earthy patchouli, creating a fragrance that feels both adventurous and luxurious. Many fragrance enthusiasts compare its overall style to powerful marine niche fragrances, while noting its sweeter and more approachable character.

Perfect for:

  • Date nights
  • Spring & summer evenings
  • Beach vacations
  • Night outings
  • Signature scent wearers
  • Niche fragrance enthusiasts
  • Those looking for a unique marine fragrance

Try Before You Commit

In the dry down, vanilla, amber, patchouli, and cypriol create a smooth, warm foundation that lingers for hours. If you enjoy fragrances that blend fresh aquatic elements with rich amber and vanilla sweetness, Nomad offers a unique and memorable experience that stands apart from traditional fresh scents.
